backend/main.mo: Motoko actor for a home services backend that manages bookings and reviews, supporting CRUD operations with filtering by service type and rating, and includes blob storage mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing three implemented features: painting price reductions, cleaning service price updates with inspection flow labels, and WhatsApp CTA button URL updates across frontend components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend file paths to short summaries describing each component's purpose, covering pages, layout, cards, forms, and hooks for the TrustFix home services app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry file defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the TrustFix React app with viewport meta, cache-control headers, Google site verification, and a root div mounting the Vite/React module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for Home, Services, Booking, Contact, and Reviews pages wrapped in a shared Layout and QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/CleaningServiceC: Card component for cleaning services that renders either a standard price booking card or a 'Free Inspection → Quote → Service' flow card based on the item's variant, with WhatsApp CTA links.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Auto-scrolling carousel that fetches and displays up to 5 featured reviews from the backend actor, with navigation arrows, dot indicators, and star ratings.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Empty file, likely a placeholder for a floating call button component.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Renders a fixed floating WhatsApp button in the bottom-right corner that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link when clicked.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying the TrustFix brand, contact info, social links, list of services, and quick navigation links with copyright notice.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with a background image, headline, and two CTA buttons (WhatsApp booking and call) plus trust-indicator stats for TrustFix.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that composes Navbar, Footer, and FloatingWhatsAppButton around page content, and scrolls to top on route changes.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop nav links, a phone CTA, and a collapsible mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/PaintingServiceC: Card component for a painting package showing image, price per sqft, rating, features list, and WhatsApp booking/details buttons.
Card component for a pest control service item displaying an image, optional price badge, description, and a WhatsApp booking button.
frontend/src/components/PricingCard.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Displays a customer review with avatar initials, service label, star rating, formatted date, and review text.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Generic service card showing an image, category badge, name, description, starting price, and a Book Now button that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: Renders a responsive grid of service category cards with scroll-triggered fade-in animations, navigating to individual service pages on click.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: Displays a row of star icons for a given rating, with optional interactive mode that calls a callback when a star is clicked.
Renders a card for a service subcategory item with an image, description, and a WhatsApp 'Get Quote' link.
A form component that lets users submit a review (name, service, star rating, text) to the backend canister, showing a success message on completion.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and a static array of home service data (pest control, cleaning, painting, etc.) along with WhatsApp contact utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
Custom hook that submits a booking to the backend canister via mutation and opens a WhatsApp confirmation message on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching featured reviews, all reviews, and all bookings from the backend canister actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Poppins and Inter fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using oklch colors, and declares component/utility styles including WhatsApp float button, wave section, and keyframe animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then mounts it to the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: Booking page component with a form for selecting service type, property type, date/time, and contact details; submits the booking to the backend actor and opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message on success.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying clickable cards for phone, WhatsApp, address, and email, along with a working hours table and a service area section.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that composes the hero section, trust badges bar, service category grid, 'Why Choose Us' feature cards, a reviews carousel, and a WhatsApp CTA banner.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: Reviews page that fetches all reviews from the backend actor via React Query and renders them in a grid of ReviewCard components alongside a WriteReviewForm, with loading skeleton and empty-state handling.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: Dynamic service detail page that looks up a service by route param and conditionally renders pest control, cleaning, painting, or subcategory card layouts with a WhatsApp booking link.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, defining dark mode, custom colors (brand-blue, shadcn CSS variables), fonts (Inter, Poppins), border radii, box shadows, and custom animations/keyframes. Uses the tailwindcss-animate plugin.
project_state.json: Tracks the TrustFix project state including completed and pending feature requests such as painting price reductions, cleaning price updates, WhatsApp CTA linking, service click isolation, booking form property types, and architectural constraints to preserve existing design.
